description: 平成年熊本地震に係る応急仮設住宅等の入居状況の推移 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本県. 平成２８年熊本に係る地震応急仮設住宅等の入居状況の推移です。. Coverage: 熊本県. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本県. Its tags are 健康福祉部. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-03-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
